STEP 1 - Scene: A single slice of pepperoni pizza (thin-to-medium crust, cheese, four-plus pepperoni rounds) on a white square-ish plate, photographed from above at a near-overhead angle on a wooden table.

STEP 2 - Ruler: The plate is a square-cornered white dinner-style plate, roughly 26 cm across its longest undistorted edge. Radius 13 cm, area ≈ 3.14 x 13² ≈ 530 cm². The pizza slice is about two-thirds of the plate's width at its base, so the food visibly spans roughly 20 cm of length.

STEP 3 - Items: (a) pizza slice dough/crust, (b) melted cheese, (c) pepperoni slices (4 whole, plus partial one at lower left).

STEP 4 - Area: Slice footprint is roughly a triangle/wedge about 20 cm x 12 cm at its widest, around 120 cm² actual footprint, i.e. ~23% of the plate. Breakdown: crust and cheese base ~18% (the bulk of the slice), pepperoni ~5% (four rounds of ~3 cm diameter ≈ 7 cm² each, about 28 cm² total).

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Crust + cheese base: 18% = 95 cm² x 1.2 cm ≈ 114 ml
- Pepperoni: 5% = 27 cm² x 0.4 cm ≈ 11 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Crust + cheese: 114 ml x 0.9 ≈ 103 g (bread-like with cheese)
- Pepperoni: 11 ml x 1.0 ≈ 11 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Pizza crust with cheese (cooked, as plated): ~270 kcal/100 g → 103 g ≈ 278 kcal
- Pepperoni: ~490 kcal/100 g → 11 g ≈ 54 kcal

Total ≈ 114 g, ≈ 332 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A single standard slice of pepperoni pizza is typically 100–140 g and 250–350 kcal, so this estimate is plausible for what is visible.
